jobs.descriptionHtml:
About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company committed to ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Our mission requires a team that brings diverse perspectives, strong judgment, and a deep commitment to safe and beneficial deployment.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced APAC Field Marketing Lead to build and lead OpenAI’s B2B demand-generation engine across the region. Reporting to the APAC B2B Lead, this person will own the regional strategy that turns market opportunity into repeatable, measurable pipeline.

This is a senior, hands-on role at the intersection of digital demand generation, field marketing, and regional enablement. You will build scale programs that country teams can localize and deploy, while partnering closely with APAC event teams to make events a more strategic, measurable part of the demand-generation mix.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute APAC B2B demand-generation strategy aligned with GTM, revenue, segment, and pipeline priorities

  • Build scale digital programs across lifecycle, webinars, nurture, paid/owned channels

  • Create regional campaign frameworks, content kits, audience strategies, and localization guidance that help country teams move faster and perform better

  • Partner with country marketers and GTM leaders to identify local pipeline gaps, adapt programs, and prioritize support

  • Lead demand-generation strategy for the APAC event portfolio, including event selection, audience acquisition, sales plays, follow-up, conversion, and ROI

  • Connect events, digital journeys, content, and Sales follow-up into integrated full-funnel programs

  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Marketing Ops on funnel health, lead quality, attribution, dashboards, and experimentation

  • Translate global B2B programs into APAC-ready motions and bring regional insights back into global strategy

  • Manage agencies, vendors, budgets, timelines, reporting, and post-program learning loops

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm for planning, performance reviews, and investment decisions

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in B2B, enterprise, field, demand-generation, or integrated marketing, ideally across multiple APAC markets

  • Proven track record building digital and scale programs that generate or influence enterprise pipeline

  • Strong experience with lifecycle, webinars, events, content, paid/owned channels, and Sales follow-up

  • Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales and RevOps to improve funnel performance and connect marketing to revenue outcomes

  • Experience supporting distributed country teams and influencing effectively in a regional-global matrix

  • Strong strategic judgment on event portfolio choices, audience strategy, and post-event conversion

  • Analytical fluency with CRM, marketing automation, attribution, dashboards, and campaign performance data

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presence

  • High ownership, adaptability, and comfort building systems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience marketing AI, developer, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, data, or other technical products

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, event platforms, intent tools, and marketing analytics workflows

  • Experience with partner-led GTM, ecosystem co-marketing, or account-based orchestration

  • Exposure to regulated or trust-sensitive industries across APAC

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies or global-local matrix organizations

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Legal-SF
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We embed deeply with users to solve high-leverage problems. We move quickly from prototype to deployment and surface patterns that shape the platform. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core development. We work closely with Product, Research, and Go-To-Market (GTM).

About the role

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to build and deploy AI systems for legal work. You will embed deeply with customers—often working closely with senior legal practitioners—to identify the right first use case, rapidly prototype a solution, and prove measurable value. Early engagements may focus on creating a “hero” workflow that shows how OpenAI’s models can support legal analysis, drafting, research, or real-time work with complex case records.

You will own the technical work from discovery and proof of concept through production adoption, while translating customer workflows and constraints into clear product feedback. As the motion matures, you will turn successful deployments into repeatable patterns that can scale across larger accounts and the broader legal market.

This role is based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% may be required.

In this role, you will

  • Embed with law firms and legal teams to understand their workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and select the right initial use cases to prove value.

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

  • Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

  • Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

  • Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

  • Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 5+ years of software engineering, ML engineering, or technical deployment experience with customer-facing ownership in financial services or adjacent regulated industries.

  • Have experience with legal technology, legal services, compliance-heavy workflows, or professional services; this is helpful but not required.

  • Have owned complex AI or data-driven systems end-to-end, from scoping through production adoption, in environments where errors carry real financial or regulatory consequences.

  • Write and review production-grade code across backend and frontend systems using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks.

  • Have deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behavior, evaluation, and guardrails affect user trust and business outcomes.

  • Communicate clearly across engineering, product, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders, translating technical trade-offs into decision quality and risk posture.

  • Apply systems thinking with high execution standards, turning incidents, escalations, and failures into improved operating standards and repeatable deployment patterns.

  • Stay calm and decisive when delivery is urgent, ambiguous, and high-stakes.

jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Architects
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Paris, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers across the South EMEA region. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

  • Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture across Europe, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements.

  • Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

  • Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.

  • Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth.

  • Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices.

  • Foster a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, and effective specialist handoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment.

  • Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises.

  • Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams.

  • Have guided enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact.

  • Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers.

  • Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements.

  • Exercise strong architectural judgment, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems.

  • Are comfortable leading across SEMEA and partnering across European markets from Paris, adapting your approach to different industries, cultures, regulatory contexts, and customer operating models.

  • Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership.

  • Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

jobs.title: Systems Test Engineer, End-to-End Validation | Consumer Devices
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. Guided by OpenAI’s mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, our team combines world-class researchers, engineers, designers, and operators who care deeply about creating useful, intuitive, and responsible technology. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside exceptional people on ambitious, zero-to-one challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI. This is a chance to help define an entirely new category of products—and shape how people experience AI in the future.

The Systems Integration team is critical in this mission, turning complex hardware-software development into reliable product signals. We validate complete device experiences across software, cloud services, connectivity, accessories, and real-world operating environments, combining hands-on system testing, structured test development, hardware-in-the-loop environments, diagnostics, and automation to uncover issues that component-level testing alone cannot reveal.

About the Role

As a Systems Test Engineer, End-to-End Validation, you will design and execute end-to-end testing for complex device experiences spanning hardware, software, connectivity, cloud services, and accessories. You’ll translate product behavior and real-world use cases into structured, reproducible test procedures and build test environments that allow failures to be reliably reproduced and diagnosed.

You’ll also identify opportunities to automate repetitive or high-value scenarios, working with engineers to turn complex manual workflows into scalable validation systems. Because this is a new category of devices, you’ll have the opportunity to build the end-to-end validation foundation early—shaping test coverage, environments, and workflows from prototype through launch.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong systems thinking, hands-on testing skills, technical curiosity, and a rigorous approach to reproducing and diagnosing failures across multiple components.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of four days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design end-to-end test coverage: Develop structured test plans and reproducible procedures for user journeys, realistic usage patterns, edge cases, degraded conditions, and failure scenarios across devices, services, connectivity, and accessories.

  • Build and operate complex test environments: Maintain setups involving devices, servers, networks, accounts, peripherals, accessories, and controlled environmental conditions; prepare devices and environments for release validation, execute test campaigns, track results, and communicate risks and blocking issues.

  • Reproduce failures and diagnose systems: Reproduce complex failures, isolate contributing components, collect logs and telemetry, and provide engineers with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence.

  • Automate high-value scenarios: Identify repeatable manual workflows that benefit from automation and develop or partner on tooling for device control, setup, measurement, data collection, and test execution.

  • Strengthen regression coverage: Convert field issues, production failures, and previously discovered bugs into repeatable regression tests and maintain coverage across product releases.

  • Partner across teams: Work with embedded, systems, cloud, hardware, QA, and product teams to understand system behavior, improve testability, and close gaps in validation coverage.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience with system-level, integration, end-to-end, or validation testing for complex hardware-software products.

  • Skill in translating loosely defined product behavior into clear, repeatable, and measurable test procedures.

  • Experience testing systems that span devices, networks, backend services, mobile applications, or connected accessories.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy hands-on debugging and can methodically isolate failures across hardware, firmware, software, connectivity, and cloud services.

  • Are comfortable working with logs, diagnostics, command-line tools, network tools, and device configuration utilities.

  • Have experience automating tests or test setups using Python or similar scripting tools, while recognizing when manual testing provides better coverage.

  • Understand how to create reliable test environments with controlled setup, configuration, preconditions, expected results, and recovery procedures.

  • Are comfortable working across engineering disciplines and communicating complex failures with clear evidence and reproducible steps.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Ads Solutions Engineer to partner with advertisers and agencies throughout the pre-sales and growth lifecycle, helping them successfully evaluate, launch, and scale on OpenAI’s advertising platform. You will serve as the technical expert in the sales process, translating advertiser objectives into scalable technical solutions across measurement, integrations, data activation, and campaign execution.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, and engineering. You’ll work closely with Client Partners, Customer Success Managers, Product, Engineering, Policy, and Operations teams to remove technical blockers, accelerate revenue growth, and shape the future of OpenAI’s ads platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with Client Partners during the sales cycle to provide technical expertise that unlocks new business and accelerates deal closure.

  • Lead technical discovery with advertisers and agencies to understand data flows, martech stack, measurement requirements, and activation goals.

  • Design and recommend implementation approaches for pixels, APIs, server-to-server integrations, identity solutions, offline conversions, and measurement frameworks.

  • Guide advertisers through onboarding and launch readiness, ensuring successful setup of tracking, attribution, audience signals, and reporting.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to implementation, signal quality, delivery, and measurement performance.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to escalate issues, advocate for customer needs, and influence roadmap priorities.

  • Create repeatable technical documentation, playbooks, and best practices that scale advertiser adoption globally.

  • Help train internal sales and success teams on technical capabilities, integrations, and evolving product features.

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, adtech, martech, or a related client-facing technical role.

  • Have hands-on experience with digital advertising measurement, pixels, conversion APIs, mobile measurement, identity solutions, or CRM/data integrations.

  • Understand advertiser ecosystems including tag managers, CDPs, analytics tools, attribution platforms, and data warehouses.

 - Partner with Client Partners during the sales cycle to provide technical expertise that unlocks new business and accelerates deal closure.

 - Lead technical discovery with advertisers and agencies to understand data flows, martech stack, measurement requirements, and activation goals.

 - Guide advertisers through onboarding and launch readiness, ensuring successful setup of tracking, attribution, audience signals, and reporting.

 - Troubleshoot technical issues related to implementation, signal quality, delivery, and measurement performance.

 - Build compelling demos, proofs of concept, and technical narratives that demonstrate the value of OpenAI’s ads solutions.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to escalate issues, advocate for customer needs, and influence roadmap priorities.

 - Create repeatable technical documentation, playbooks, and best practices that scale advertiser adoption globally.

 - Help train internal sales and success teams on technical capabilities, integrations, and evolving product features.

 - Have 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, adtech, martech, or a related client-facing technical role.

jobs.title: Executive Programs Lead, Americas
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Enterprise Marketing helps the world’s largest organizations understand, adopt, and scale AI. Our Executive Engagement programs bring OpenAI’s products, research, and perspective into the room with senior leaders as they consider how intelligence can be put to work against their most important priorities.

These engagements are more than briefings or events. At their best, they help a leadership team understand what is changing, distinguish what is possible now from what is still emerging, and leave with greater clarity about what to do next.

About the Role

We are looking for an Executive Programs Lead, Americas to build and lead the portfolio through which OpenAI engages its most important customers and executives across the region.

You will own the regional strategy, team, and quality bar for Executive Briefings and a broader portfolio of C-suite engagements, recurring executive forums, advisory programs, and proven formats ready to scale. Your mandate is to turn high-stakes customer moments into a durable business capability, one that consistently advances important relationships while preserving the judgment and customization that exceptional executive experiences require.

This is a senior people-leadership role for a builder who can set direction, make disciplined portfolio choices, and create the systems and team required to deliver at scale. You will partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Research, Solutions, Customer Success, Events, and OpenAI executives, moving comfortably between long-term design and the critical details of a live engagement.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid model of three days in the office each week and offer relocation assistance. Given the customer-facing nature of the role, regular in-person participation in executive briefings and related preparation is expected and may require additional time onsite. Travel across the Americas and occasional global travel are also expected.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the Americas portfolio of recurring executive-engagement programs and the regional capability that supports them, setting its strategy, priorities, investments, and measures of success.

  • Lead and develop the regional team responsible for program strategy, operations, and delivery, creating clear ownership and an unusually high standard of execution.

  • Translate enterprise and regional priorities into a focused portfolio, including where executive engagement can materially advance an important customer relationship or business outcome.

  • Build an operating model that enables consistent quality and responsible scale while preserving the judgment required to determine what should be repeatable and what should remain bespoke.

  • Ensure priority programs bring together the right customer context, narrative, speakers, demos, experience, and follow-through.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and customer-facing teams to connect each engagement to meaningful customer objectives, decisions, and next steps.

  • Establish measures that connect customer insight, relationship progress, business results, experience quality, and operational health.

  • Manage regional resources, budget, vendors, and capacity with discipline, making clear tradeoffs and surfacing risks early.

  • Represent the Americas in global planning and help successful approaches travel across regions while preserving what needs to remain locally owned.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years of experience building or leading executive programs, customer engagement, enterprise marketing, experience centers, field marketing, or a comparable enterprise capability.

  • Have led and developed a high-performing team with accountability for a visible portfolio, not only individual programs.

  • Have built or transformed a high-touch customer capability, moving it from reactive or heavily bespoke delivery toward a more strategic and scalable model.

  • Bring strong commercial judgment and credibility with senior Sales leaders, customers, and internal executives.

  • Understand the difference between an exceptional executive experience and a polished event—and can connect that experience to meaningful customer and business progress.

  • Know how to prioritize rigorously, say no constructively, and make difficult resource decisions without losing stakeholder trust.

  • Can translate strategy into a working system with clear ownership, strong standards, and reliable execution.

  • Can operate credibly in a fast-moving technical environment and build effective partnerships across Product, Research, Marketing, Sales, and customer-facing teams.

  • Move comfortably between setting direction, developing leaders, reviewing the system, and personally stepping into a critical moment.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers’ experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products.

Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Advertiser Support Specialist to help build and scale advertiser support within Ads Safety Operations. You’ll work directly with advertisers through support tickets, escalations, owning high-impact questions related to ads policies, review outcomes, product behavior, and operational processes. Many cases will be novel or ambiguous, and you’ll be expected to investigate carefully, communicate clearly, and drive them to resolution in a fast-moving product environment.

As OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem grows, your work will help advertisers operate successfully at scale while serving as a critical bridge between frontline support and the teams responsible for product quality, policy integrity, and platform safety. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native environment. You’ll turn support interactions into operational intelligence, identifying recurring friction, gaps in guidance, and emerging issues to improve support at scale, and protect the quality and safety of OpenAI’s ad ecosystem. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Policy, Legal and Go To Market partners to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

In this role, you will:

  • Own advertiser cases from initial intake through resolution, including complex or sensitive Ads Trust & Safety escalations; investigate whether issues stem from policy, review operations, product behavior, tooling, or another dependency, then communicate clear next steps and follow through.

  • Develop deep expertise across advertiser workflows, ads policies, enforcement processes, review systems, and support tooling.

  • Build a detailed view of advertiser friction by combining ticket themes, escalation patterns, quality findings, and service metrics to prioritize improvements and identify emerging experience or safety gaps.

  • Turn frontline learnings into clearer help content, stronger playbooks, better routing and escalation criteria, improved knowledge management and quality standards, and self-service opportunities.

  • Partner with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and Go To Market teams to resolve recurring issues, surface advertiser feedback, and scale durable solutions.

  • Drive operational excellence through AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, improve team efficiency, and elevate support quality.

  • Support readiness for new ads formats, features, and markets by anticipating advertiser questions and identifying support risks early.

  • Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in customer support, user operations, ads operations, Trust & Safety, risk operations, escalations, or a related field, including ownership of high-impact customer or advertiser cases.

  • Bring strong investigative judgment and can translate ambiguous signals into policy support, operational gaps, product defects, and expected behavior

  • Can synthesize data trends, feedback, QA findings, and service metrics into clear priorities and system improvement while maintaining strong judgment and safeguards

  • Have improved support processes, knowledge bases, escalation workflows, routing systems, or quality programs.

  • Are comfortable using AI and emerging technologies (i.e. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) and/or code (e.g. Python) to automate repetitive tasks and integrating tools

  • Build trust with cross-functional partners, communicate clearly and empathetically with advertisers and internal teams, and drive action without formal authority.

  • Thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and bring a humble, service-oriented mindset.

OpenAI’s User Operations team ensures that our customers’ experience is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide guidance, and support customers in maximizing value with our products.

Within User Operations, Ads Safety Operations helps OpenAI grow advertising in a way that is safe, trusted, and sustainable for advertisers, users and the business. The Ads Safety Support team sits within Ads Safety Operations and owns the advertiser-facing support journey: helping advertisers navigate ads products, policies, reviews, and enforcement decisions while turning frontline insights into better guidance, tooling, and product experiences.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Advertiser Support Specialist to help build and scale advertiser support within Ads Safety Operations. You’ll work directly with advertisers through support tickets, escalations, owning high-impact questions related to ads policies, review outcomes, product behavior, and operational processes.  Many cases will be novel or ambiguous, and you’ll be expected to investigate carefully, communicate clearly, and drive them to resolution in a fast-moving product environment.

As OpenAI’s advertising ecosystem grows, your work will help advertisers operate successfully at scale while serving as a critical bridge between frontline support and the teams responsible for product quality, policy integrity, and platform safety. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native environment. You’ll turn support interactions into operational intelligence, identifying recurring friction, gaps in guidance, and emerging issues to improve support at scale, and protect the quality and safety of OpenAI’s ad ecosystem.  You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Policy, Legal and Go To Market partners to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

In this role, you will:

 - Own advertiser cases from initial intake through resolution, including complex or sensitive Ads Trust & Safety escalations; investigate whether issues stem from policy, review operations, product behavior, tooling, or another dependency, then communicate clear next steps and follow through.

 - Develop deep expertise across advertiser workflows, ads policies, enforcement processes, review systems, and support tooling.

 - Build a detailed view of advertiser friction by combining ticket themes, escalation patterns, quality findings, and service metrics to prioritize improvements and identify emerging experience or safety gaps.

 - Turn frontline learnings into clearer help content, stronger playbooks, better routing and escalation criteria, improved knowledge management and quality standards, and self-service opportunities.

 - Partner with Product, Policy, Engineering, Legal, Data Science, and Go To Market teams to resolve recurring issues, surface advertiser feedback, and scale durable solutions.

 - Drive operational excellence through AI-assisted workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, improve team efficiency, and elevate support quality.

 - Support readiness for new ads formats, features, and markets by anticipating advertiser questions and identifying support risks early.

 - Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 6+ years of experience in customer support, user operations, ads operations, Trust & Safety, risk operations, escalations, or a related field, including ownership of high-impact customer or advertiser cases.

 - Bring strong investigative judgment and can translate ambiguous signals into policy support, operational gaps, product defects, and expected behavior

 - Can synthesize data trends, feedback, QA findings, and service metrics into clear priorities and system improvement while maintaining strong judgment and safeguards

 - Have improved support processes, knowledge bases, escalation workflows, routing systems, or quality programs.

 - Are comfortable using AI and emerging technologies (i.e. Codex, ChatGPT, OpenAI API, etc.) and/or code (e.g. Python) to automate repetitive tasks and integrating tools

 - Build trust with cross-functional partners, communicate clearly and empathetically with advertisers and internal teams, and drive action without formal authority.

 - Thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and bring a humble, service-oriented mindset.

 - Bonus: Understand advertiser workflows, ads ecosystems, policy enforcement, account reviews, or ads safety operations.






About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

jobs.title: Startup Content Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of AI. With that aim in mind, we are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform amongst our core audiences.

We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with product, engineering, developer relations, comms, and sales teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels.

Our focus extends beyond just promoting product features; we aim to provide valuable insights and resources that help our users make the most out of AI technologies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Startup Content Marketing Manager who loves technology and wants to work closely with the founders building new products and companies with OpenAI.

At OpenAI, you’ll work inside the company building the models and directly with founders turning those capabilities into new products and companies. You’ll try what they’re building and dig into the ideas, technical choices, and lessons behind their work. You’ll turn those discoveries into founder stories, practical guides, demos, and campaigns that help other builders see what’s possible and imagine what they could create next.

 
 

This is a high-agency, hands-on individual-contributor role. You’ll own campaigns from the first founder conversation through publication and results. You’ll work with startup customers, ecosystem partners, and colleagues across OpenAI, with room to follow a promising idea, try an unexpected format, and make something founders genuinely want to read, watch, and share.

In this role, you will:

  • Build relationships with founders and technical teams, get hands-on with their products, and uncover stories and practical lessons other builders can apply to their own work.

  • Own defined startup content campaigns from the first idea and creative brief through production, distribution, and measurement.

  • Support co-marketing programs with startup customers and ecosystem partners, helping turn their work into stories that are valuable to both the featured company and the wider founder community.

  • Write, create, and coordinate founder profiles, customer stories, practical guides, demos, and other content across social, email, events, partner channels, and founder communities.

  • Partner with field and events teams to capture compelling ideas, conversations, and product moments, then turn them into content that reaches well beyond the room.

  • Work with startup GTM, customer marketing, product marketing, social, and communications to make each story accurate, distinctive, and useful to its intended audience.

  • Build clear briefs, editorial calendars, and repeatable workflows that help good ideas move quickly from discovery to publication.

  • Define success, track performance, and use audience feedback and data to improve the stories, formats, and channels you pursue next.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 4+ years of experience in B2B, content, customer, or integrated marketing.

  • Have worked with startup, founder, builder, or developer audiences and understand what earns their attention and trust.

  • Can point to content campaigns or co-marketing programs you helped bring to life, explain your contribution, and show what you learned from the results.

  • Take ownership of a defined project, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and keep work moving through ambiguity.

  • Proactively identify and resolve blockers, flag risks early, and know when to ask for a decision, more context, or cross-functional support.

  • Build strong relationships with founders, customers, and colleagues, and can bring people with different priorities together around a clear plan.

  • Love the craft of storytelling. You ask good questions, notice the revealing detail, and can explain a technical idea clearly without losing what makes it interesting or accurate.

  • Are deeply curious about technology and AI. You enjoy trying new products, understanding how they work, and talking with the people building them.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - Contract
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We’re seeking a Contract Recruiting Coordinator to join our team, focusing on supporting the logistics and coordination of the recruiting efforts for OpenAI.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as point of contact for candidates; coordinating, scheduling, and managing interviews as well as travel and accommodation arrangements when needed. Making sure everyone is in the right place at the right time.

  • Use Ashby (our ATS) and relevant recruiting tools to stay organized and help keep our busy team on track.

  • Work with our team to support OpenAI’s recruiting team. This will include supporting multiple functions, cross-training, hosting and scheduling support and completing assigned tasks.

  • Handle high-volume global scheduling of interviews: phone screens, video conferencing, presentations and onsite interviews.

  • Communicate updates to candidates regarding their applicant/interview status as needed.

  • Develop strong candidate and stakeholder relationships (Hiring Managers, Recruiting, etc.) and maintaining effective communication channels.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 2+ years of experience in a fast paced recruiting coordinator position.

  • Are passionate about candidate experience: we see our candidates as our guests, and we are their hosts. It is the coordinator's job to ensure a smooth experience.

  • Are detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to multitask.

  • An excellent communicator, both written and verbal. With an appropriate blend of professionalism and friendliness.

  • Are self-directed with a high sense of urgency while maintaining a meticulous attention to detail.

  • Anticipate possible issues before they arise and effectively problem-solves in advance. This includes independently making quick, educated decisions.

  • Have ability to maintain a high degree of professionalism and a calm demeanor.

  • Are willing to take initiative and have the confidence to keep interviews running on time and hold stakeholders accountable in order to maintain a positive candidate experience.

Additional details:

  • This is a temporary contract assignment supporting OpenAI.

  • The role will be employed and paid through our third-party staffing agency.

  • This role can be based in one of our offices: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, or Seattle, WA.

Our offices follow a hybrid work model: three days in the office each week, with the option to work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. Our open-plan spaces feature height-adjustable desks, conference rooms, phone booths, well-stocked kitchens with snacks and drinks, and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform.

We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Scientist to join OpenAI’s Ads Marketing Science function. Reporting to Marketing Science leadership, you’ll be a senior individual contributor who combines rigorous measurement expertise with strong client judgment and hands-on execution.

Your mission is to help OpenAI Ads prove and improve advertisers’ media performance. You’ll work with sales, partners, and clients supporting all forms of measurement including verification, attribution, incrementality, brand, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and scalable advertiser reporting, connecting sound methodology to decisions advertisers can act on.

You will partner closely with Sales on key advertising accounts and with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Partnerships, Legal, and Privacy. Initial priorities include advancing incrementality measurement, helping onboard measurement partners to privacy-forward measurement workflows and integrations, and creating reusable programs, tools, agents, skills, and workflows that let sales and clients access high-quality Marketing Science support at scale.

This role is based in either San Francisco or New York, and follows a hybrid schedule (Monday-Wednesday).

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with Sales, advertisers, and agencies to shape learning agendas, interpret results, and improve media performance.

  • Apply rigorous advertising measurement approaches across attribution, incrementality, marketing mix modeling, and other relevant methodologies.

  • Develop scalable measurement programs and guidance that improve decisions and adoption of rigorous measurement practices.

  • Shape advertiser-facing insights experiences that translate campaign and audience data into actionable performance recommendations.

  • Conduct auction optimization analyses to identify delivery, pricing, and performance opportunities that improve advertiser outcomes.

  • Communicate complex concepts clearly and uphold high standards for privacy, quality, transparency, and responsible interpretation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have deep expertise (10+ years) in advertising measurement, including experimentation, incrementality testing, attribution, and econometric approaches such as MMM.

  • Are a hands-on senior individual contributor who works directly with large datasets using SQL, Python or R, and AI-enabled analytical workflows, without sacrificing rigor or judgment.

  • Are a trusted client advisor who can navigate sophisticated advertiser questions, measurement discrepancies, and executive conversations with clarity and sound judgment.

  • Have designed or operated lift and incrementality programs, including experiment design, power analysis, governance, diagnostics, and statistical quality standards.

  • Bring experience with third-party measurement providers, partner onboarding, APIs or data integrations, and translating partner needs into practical product requirements.

  • Have partnered effectively with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to turn measurement methodology into scalable tools, reporting, or platform capabilities.

  • Can translate complex statistical concepts into practical decisions for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments and can influence across teams without relying on formal authority.

  • Care deeply about privacy-forward, trustworthy measurement that helps advertisers understand, prove, and improve media performance.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our Trust, Safety & Risk Operations teams safeguard our products, users, and the company from abuse, fraud, scams, regulatory non-compliance, and other emerging risks. We operate at the intersection of operations, compliance, user trust, and safety working closely with Legal, Policy, Engineering, Product, Go-To-Market, and external partners to ensure our platforms are safe, compliant, and trusted by a diverse, global user base.

The Global Safety Response Operations team provides 24/7 coverage for user safety, risk, and regulatory escalations across OpenAI’s products, handling the highest-priority cases that require human judgment and rapid response. The team operates as the core escalation and delivery arm of OpenAI’s safety operations, ensuring that our products remain safe and aligned with policy while enabling timely, empathetic, and consistent user support.

About the Role

The Global Safety Response Operations Lead is a hands-on team lead who both manages a regional Safety Response team and personally handles high-risk safety cases. This role combines frontline safety work with people leadership, operational ownership, and cross-functional coordination.

You will lead a team of Safety Response Analysts who handle OpenAI’s most sensitive and high-impact cases, while also personally contributing to casework for complex, high-risk, or high-visibility issues. You will own the execution of high severity escalations in your region and ensure proper execution and communication to cross functional stakeholders

You will be accountable for ensuring your region consistently meets utilization, quality, and SLA targets while serving as the operational interface with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and regional stakeholders.

This is a 24/7 global operation that requires flexibility to support rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a leadership on-call model.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Lead and coach a regional team of Safety Response Analysts, ensuring high performance, engagement, and consistent decision quality.

  • Own regional operational outcomes, including utilization, SLA adherence, backlog health, and quality benchmarks.

  • Handle and oversee the most complex and high-risk cases, serving as the first line of escalation and incident lead for your region.

  • Contribute directly to frontline work (20–30%), including investigations, enforcement decisions, and regulatory or legal escalations.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and local market teams to execute safety outcomes and manage risk.

  • Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement, improving workflows, tools, automation, and escalation paths.

  • Identify emerging risks and trends, translating frontline insights into actionable recommendations for policy, product, or enforcement.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Risk Operations, Investigations, Fraud, Annotation, or platform integrity.

  • You have 4+ years of direct people leadership or senior-level operational ownership, including coaching experienced operators, setting clear direction and supporting independent judgement.

  • You have applied AI tools and automation to improve operational workflows, with sound judgment about where human review remains essential.

  • You are deeply familiar with trust and safety operations, across multiple risk areas including content moderation, user safety, fraud, or developer risk frameworks, including the legal, policy, and technical considerations that shape enforcement.

  • You are a strong decision-maker in ambiguous, high-risk environments, able to balance speed, accuracy, and defensibility when handling sensitive or high-impact cases.

  • You communicate complex safety and risk decisions clearly and credibly, whether writing escalation narratives, briefing Legal or Policy, or aligning Product and leadership during incidents.

  • You can translate between frontline operations and strategic stakeholders, turning messy real-world cases into structured insights and turning policy or product direction into clear, executable guidance for your team.

  • You are skilled at influencing without authority, building trust with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and regional partners to drive alignment and resolve ambiguity.

  • You use data, tooling, and automation to improve quality, efficiency, and scale to not just measure performance, but to make better decisions.

  • You are comfortable leading in a 24/7, high-pressure operational environment, providing calm, credible leadership during incidents, spikes, and regulatory or reputational events.

jobs.title: Manager, Senior Support Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Senior Support Engineering team is responsible for ensuring that developers and enterprises can reliably build mission critical solutions using OpenAI models. We provide technical guidance, resolve complex issues and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our highly-capable models. We work closely with Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. We think from an automation-first mindset and leverage the latest in AI to scale our support operations. Join the Senior Support Engineering (SSE) team at OpenAI and help shape the future of Technical Support in the age of AI.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Support Engineering Manager to build and guide a high-performing team of experienced Senior Support Engineers with backgrounds in software engineering, site reliability engineering, and systems architecture. These engineers are trusted to operate with autonomy, tackle deeply technical challenges, and serve as the final escalation point before Engineering.

In this role, you'll lead a team focused on deep problem-solving, proactive reliability work, and customer-specific troubleshooting. You’ll drive the design and operations of OpenAI’s incident management processes, including tooling, automations, and training, and ensure they are scalable and resilient. You’ll also oversee strategic customer workload monitoring, alerting, and a 24x7 rotation to ensure high-priority issues are caught early and handled with urgency.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Technical Success, and field teams to improve the supportability of our products, reduce operational burden, and shape the future of AI-driven technical support. Your team will own incident response playbooks, build internal automations, and serve as technical stewards for our most strategic accounts.

This is an opportunity to define what world-class technical support looks like in the era of AGI. We're looking for a leader who combines strong technical depth with operational rigor, a passion for team development, and an automation-first mindset.

The ideal candidate will have a combination of technical capabilities mixed with strong leadership and systems building strength.

We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and lead a team of deeply technical and tenured Senior Support Engineers who bring backgrounds in software engineering, site reliability engineering, and systems architecture and are experts in diagnosing and solving complex issues on OpenAI’s technologies.

  • Own the continuous improvement of our incident management processes, including tooling, automation, and team readiness.

  • Lead strategic workload health monitoring and alerting programs for key enterprise customers, ensuring effective 24x7 operational coverage.

  • Guide the team in designing and implementing automation and internal tools with an AI-first mindset to scale support operations efficiently.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams to escalate, resolve, and prevent high-impact technical issues.

  • Represent Support Engineering in customer conversations and internal forums, driving clarity and alignment on issue resolution and reliability expectations.

  • Shape support operations at scale by contributing to hiring plans and global shift coverage as we expand.

  • Play an active role in the broader Support leadership team, contributing to strategy, operations, and culture beyond your immediate team.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • 10+ years of experience in technical support engineering, software engineering, site reliability engineering, or a related technical discipline, including hands-on experience supporting production systems at scale.

  • 5+ years of experience managing engineers or leading complex, multi-person technical projects, with clear ownership over delivery, execution, and outcomes.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Lead, Brand & Policy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring that artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We develop and execute strategies that build understanding of OpenAI, deepen engagement with our key audiences, and communicate why we build, how our technology is creating value, and how we approach its broader societal impact.

We work closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Creative, Research, Product, and other teams to translate complex topics into clear, relevant, and compelling stories. Our work spans national campaigns and locally tailored efforts, helping people understand both the opportunities created by AI and the important issues surrounding its development and adoption.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Integrated Marketing Lead to lead policy- and reputation-focused campaigns that strengthen the OpenAI brand nationally and within local communities.

This person will spearhead integrated campaigns and corporate communications initiatives that help people understand why OpenAI builds, the impact of our technology, and how we are engaging with some of the most consequential issues surrounding AI—including infrastructure and data centers, jobs and economic opportunity, and youth safety.

The role combines national paid media with locally relevant marketing and engagement efforts. The ideal candidate understands policy, public affairs, and civic audiences while also being a sophisticated brand marketer who can make complex subjects accessible and meaningful to a broader public.

This person will bring strategic vision, sound judgment, organizational clarity, and exceptional execution to highly visible work. They will collaborate closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Creative, Research, and external agency partners to build trust and shape understanding of OpenAI at both the national and local levels.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead policy and brand campaign strategy: Develop integrated marketing strategies that communicate why OpenAI builds, demonstrate the real-world impact of our technology, and address important policy and societal issues.

  • Build national and local campaigns: Lead a mix of national paid-media campaigns and locally tailored efforts that reach policymakers, civic and community leaders, influential stakeholders, and the broader public.

  • Translate complex issues into compelling stories: Turn nuanced topics—including AI infrastructure, data centers, jobs, economic opportunity, and youth safety—into clear, credible, and engaging narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Own campaigns from strategy through measurement: Manage the full campaign lifecycle, including audience insights, briefs, creative development, media strategy, stakeholder alignment, execution, launch, optimization, and post-campaign analysis.

  • Connect policy expertise with brand building: Ensure policy-focused communications strengthen the broader OpenAI brand, create greater understanding of our mission, and build long-term trust.

  • Champion creative excellence: Partner with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop distinctive, culturally relevant work while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment on sensitive topics.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Global Affairs, Communications, Creative, Research, Product, and other partners to align priorities, navigate complex issues, and bring campaigns to market effectively.

  • Develop audience and market insight: Build a deep understanding of policy, civic, and local audiences and use research, data, and cultural insight to determine the most effective messages, channels, and messengers.

  • Measure and improve impact: Establish clear campaign objectives and measurement plans, using results and audience feedback to continuously strengthen our strategy and execution.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Relevant experience: 12+ years of experience in integrated marketing, brand marketing, corporate reputation, public affairs, policy communications, or advertising, including significant experience leading complex, high-profile campaigns.

  • Policy audience expertise: A strong understanding of policymakers, civic leaders, advocacy organizations, community stakeholders, and other audiences that influence public understanding and policy conversations.

  • Brand-building experience: A demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical subjects into accessible stories that strengthen reputation, build trust, and connect a brand with a broad public audience.

  • National and local campaign experience: Proven success developing national campaigns as well as locally tailored marketing or public-affairs efforts informed by regional and community context.

  • Paid-media expertise: Experience leading substantial paid-media campaigns across channels such as television, digital video, social, print, audio, out-of-home, and local media.

  • Integrated campaign leadership: Proven success managing campaigns across paid, owned, earned, experiential, and community channels, with strong strategic and project-management skills.

  • Exceptional judgment: The ability to navigate sensitive, fast-moving, and highly visible issues with care, accuracy, and an understanding of reputational and policy considerations.

  • Communication and influence: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and influence decisions at the executive level.

  • Cross-functional leadership: A track record of bringing together teams with different perspectives and areas of expertise to deliver against a shared objective.

  • Agility and adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adjusting strategies in response to new developments, audience insights, and external dynamics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing campaigns related to technology policy, corporate reputation, economic impact, infrastructure, workforce issues, online or youth safety, or other complex societal topics.

  • Experience partnering closely with public policy, government affairs, corporate communications, research, and community-engagement teams.

  • Experience managing creative and media agencies and substantial campaign budgets.

  • A passion for storytelling and for making complex ideas understandable, relevant, and human.

  • A test-and-learn mindset grounded in research, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence, emerging technology, and the evolving public conversation surrounding their impact.

Workplace & Location

  • San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday.

  • Optional locations: Washington DC or New York. If you're in either of these locations, you will need to travel to SF on a frequent basis.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence With that aim in mind, we are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform amongst our core audiences. We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels. Our focus extends beyond just promoting product features; we aim to provide valuable insights and resources that help our users make the most out of AI technologies.


About the Role

As a Product Marketing Manager for Partner Marketing on the Hardware team, you will help shape the partnership strategy for a new product ecosystem and bring that ecosystem to market with the right partners, programs, and commercial motions. This role calls for a strategic, relationship-oriented marketer who can identify high-potential partners, understand their priorities, and turn shared opportunities into durable, high-impact go-to-market plans.

You will work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Integrated Marketing, Sales, Comms, Finance, Legal, and partner-facing teams to define how first-, second-, and third-party partners participate in our hardware ecosystem. You will lead the marketing and commercial aspects of partnerships, support joint launches, and ensure partner needs are understood internally while OpenAI’s product, brand, and customer experience standards are represented externally.

This role reports into the VP of Product Marketing, Hardware, and offers a unique opportunity to build the partner marketing foundation for a new category of AI-powered devices.

In this role, you will:

  • Help craft and implement the partnership strategy for OpenAI’s hardware product ecosystem.

  • Identify, prioritize, and evaluate potential partners for participation in first-, second-, and third-party partner programs.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners, serving as a trusted counterpart through launches, growth moments, ambiguity, and challenges.

  • Understand partner stakeholders, business models, priorities, and constraints, and advocate for those perspectives internally.

  • Lead the commercial marketing aspects of partnerships, including positioning, launch strategy, sales enablement, distribution, and joint marketing plans.

  • Manage partner execution for joint product launches, campaigns, events, and other go-to-market efforts.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales, Comms, and Integrated Marketing to align partner strategy with product and business goals.

  • Develop partner narratives, messaging, and materials that clearly communicate the value of OpenAI’s hardware products and ecosystem.

  • Monitor partner performance, market feedback, and customer signals to improve future programs and deepen partner impact.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10+ years of experience in product marketing, partner marketing, business development marketing, ecosystem marketing, or related go-to-market roles.

  • Have experience building or scaling partner programs, ideally in consumer hardware, platforms, devices, developer ecosystems, or emerging technology categories.

  • Are highly relationship-oriented and can build trust with external partners while navigating complex internal priorities.

  • Can translate partner needs, customer insights, and product strategy into clear positioning, launch plans, and commercial programs.

  • Have led successful cross-functional launches or campaigns with multiple internal teams and external partners.

  • Bring strong business judgment across marketing, sales, distribution, and commercial partnership models.

  • Are an excellent communicator and storyteller, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.

  • Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the strategy, product, and ecosystem are being built in parallel.
