jobs.title: Development Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Site Readiness & Development team owns the upstream diligence and development work required to convert powered-land opportunities into executable infrastructure options.

About the Role

The Development Lead owns the development path after a site clears initial screening. This role validates the viable power pathway, turns site constraints into a building-level deployment plan that makes clear when each building can deploy, and runs the phase-by-phase action list that closes the decisions, dependencies, and evidence gaps needed to make a site controllable and executable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the stage-gate path from exclusivity and commercial terms through desktop diligence, confirmatory diligence, site closing, and handoff into design, construction, and operations.

  • Validate power pathways with Power and utility partners, including service options, interconnection and delivery sequencing, readiness assumptions, schedule exposure, cost implications, and decision points.

  • Turn each development phase into a disciplined action list with owners, deadlines, closure criteria, open evidence, and escalation paths; drive the list to closure rather than simply reporting status.

  • Translate power, land, civil, environmental, access, entitlement, and permitting constraints into a building-level deployment plan with clear sequencing and target deployment timing for each building.

  • Coordinate site access, exclusivity, LOI, commercial terms, financing assumptions, and closing requirements with Commercial, Legal, Finance, Power, Land, and other partner teams.

  • Define the desktop diligence scope, expected 15–30 day deliverables, and go / no-go criteria; then govern the 90–120 day confirmatory diligence plan.

  • Set and track ECDs for easements, offsite improvements, well and pipeline locating, environmental studies, water-well testing, geotechnical reports, additional land, incentives, and other site-specific workstreams.

  • Scope and manage diligence vendors and consultants, keeping their outputs tied to decisions, schedule, cost, action-list closure, and residual risk.

  • Maintain the integrated development schedule, budget implications, dependency tracker, risk register, mitigation plan, and executive escalation cadence.

  • Deliver executive-ready advance, defer, or stop recommendations and prepare the readiness package for transition into design, construction, and operations.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in land development, infrastructure development, data center development, energy-project development, electrical, mechanical, civil or environmental engineering, or related project delivery.

  • Experience advancing large-scale facility programs through early planning, power validation, phased development, site closing, and readiness handoff.

  • Strong ability to evaluate power pathways and translate utility, interconnection, and delivery findings into schedule, cost, and deployment implications.

  • Highly organized operator who can convert ambiguous diligence into owner-based action lists, closure criteria, critical paths, and executive decisions.

About the Team

OpenAI’s Healthcare team is working to ensure that advances in AI meaningfully improve health for everyone. We build AI systems that support patients, clinicians, and healthcare organizations while setting a high standard for deploying AI responsibly in a high-stakes domain.

On the Healthcare team, we are building products and infrastructure that bring OpenAI’s capabilities into healthcare organizations and clinical workflows. We serve health care systems, insurance companies, and the broad range of healthcare IT companies. Our products include connecting ChatGPT with healthcare data and systems and building reliable enterprise experiences that can operate within complex security, privacy, compliance, and interoperability requirements.

We work closely with product, research, design, security, privacy, GTM, and our healthcare customers to turn powerful AI capabilities into dependable products that clinicians and healthcare organizations use in their everyday work.

About the Role

We are looking for backend and full-stack software engineers to build the systems behind OpenAI’s healthcare products.

You will work across backend services, APIs, data systems, integrations, and product surfaces to connect AI with healthcare workflows and enterprise data. You’ll tackle the technical challenges involved in making these systems secure, reliable, observable, and scalable enough for real-world healthcare environments.

This is a product-engineering role for someone who can move between customer problems and complex system architecture, and who is comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build backend and full-stack systems powering OpenAI’s healthcare products.

  • Build services, APIs, and data pipelines that connect OpenAI products with healthcare systems and enterprise data.

  • Develop integrations with electronic health records and other healthcare data sources.

  • Design systems that meet demanding requirements around privacy, security, permissions, compliance, and data governance.

  • Own features and systems from early architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Build reliable systems capable of handling complex data flows, partial failures, and evolving integration requirements.

  • Partner closely with product, research, security, privacy, GTM, and healthcare organizations to translate real-world workflows into scalable products.

  • Improve the reliability, performance, observability, and operational maturity of production healthcare systems.

  • Take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and drive them toward practical, durable solutions.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a strong backend or full-stack engineer who enjoys building durable production systems.

  • Have 5+ years of experience writing maintainable, production-quality software.

  • Have strong experience with backend services, APIs, data systems, or distributed systems.

  • Are comfortable reasoning about system architecture, data models, authentication, permissions, and integration boundaries.

  • Have experience owning production systems at scale, including observability, testing, incident response, migrations, and rollout.

  • Can move between product requirements and technical architecture without losing ownership of either.

  • Operate with high agency and are comfortable taking ambiguous problems from definition through production.

  • Enjoy working directly with cross-functional partners and customers to understand complex workflows.

  • Care deeply about reliability, privacy, security, and correctness.

  • Are motivated by the opportunity to improve healthcare through AI.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building enterprise SaaS products or platforms.

  • Experience with distributed systems, backend architecture, or large-scale data pipelines.

  • Experience building integrations with complex third-party systems or APIs.

  • Experience with authentication, identity, permissions, or enterprise security.

  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or enterprise infrastructure.

  • Experience with healthcare interoperability, EHR systems, or healthcare data standards.

  • Experience building HIPAA-compliant products or systems.

  • Experience building applied AI or conversational products.

  • Previous experience in healthcare or health technology.

We work closely with product, research, design, security, privacy, GTM, and our healthcare customers to turn powerful AI capabilities into dependable products that clinicians and healthcare organizations use in their everyday work.



About the Role

We are looking for backend and full-stack software engineers to build the systems behind OpenAI’s healthcare products.

You will work across backend services, APIs, data systems, integrations, and product surfaces to connect AI with healthcare workflows and enterprise data. You’ll tackle the technical challenges involved in making these systems secure, reliable, observable, and scalable enough for real-world healthcare environments.

This is a product-engineering role for someone who can move between customer problems and complex system architecture, and who is comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end.



In this role, you will:

 - Design and build backend and full-stack systems powering OpenAI’s healthcare products.

 - Build services, APIs, and data pipelines that connect OpenAI products with healthcare systems and enterprise data.

 - Develop integrations with electronic health records and other healthcare data sources.

 - Design systems that meet demanding requirements around privacy, security, permissions, compliance, and data governance.

 - Own features and systems from early architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

 - Build reliable systems capable of handling complex data flows, partial failures, and evolving integration requirements.

 - Partner closely with product, research, security, privacy, GTM, and healthcare organizations to translate real-world workflows into scalable products.

 - Improve the reliability, performance, observability, and operational maturity of production healthcare systems.

 - Take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and drive them toward practical, durable solutions.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Are a strong backend or full-stack engineer who enjoys building durable production systems.

 - Have 5+ years of experience writing maintainable, production-quality software.

 - Have strong experience with backend services, APIs, data systems, or distributed systems.

 - Are comfortable reasoning about system architecture, data models, authentication, permissions, and integration boundaries.

 - Have experience owning production systems at scale, including observability, testing, incident response, migrations, and rollout.

 - Can move between product requirements and technical architecture without losing ownership of either.

 - Operate with high agency and are comfortable taking ambiguous problems from definition through production.

 - Enjoy working directly with cross-functional partners and customers to understand complex workflows.

 - Care deeply about reliability, privacy, security, and correctness.

 - Are motivated by the opportunity to improve healthcare through AI.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. We connect global product innovation with local consumer needs, culture and behavior across Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America, contributing to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

We bring together strategy and creativity across integrated campaigns, product launches, creators, social, partnerships and cultural experiences. Working with global and local cross-functional teams, we make AI’s everyday usefulness tangible and relevant to people across the region.

Our B2B work extends this mission to professionals and organizations through practical education, local customer stories and programs that support meaningful AI adoption at work.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on B2B Marketing Lead to build and lead B2B marketing across LATAM, with an immediate focus on Brazil. You will set priorities with International Expansion and local GTM teams, connect global B2B strategy with local needs, and turn those priorities into programs that help professionals and organizations understand and adopt AI. This role reports to the LATAM Marketing Lead.

You will combine customer insight, product understanding and strategic brand judgment with practical delivery across education, demand generation, customer stories, events and sales enablement. Working with Field Marketing and regional and global partners, you will build the capabilities, execution network and measurement practices needed to grow the program.This role is based in Brazil; São Paulo, hybrid model.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the LATAM B2B marketing plan, starting with Brazil: identify priority audiences, adoption barriers and opportunities, and align programs with International Expansion, GTM and global B2B objectives.

  • Translate product capabilities and global narratives into locally relevant use cases, campaigns and professional education, with accurate expectations about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Build local customer stories and practical examples with customers, Sales and Comms, ensuring the evidence supports the claims and the materials are useful to business audiences.

  • Design the partner, agency and vendor network needed to deliver the plan; define scopes, budgets, responsibilities and quality expectations with clear ownership.

  • Bring LATAM customer insights and market needs into global B2B planning, adapt shared assets and programs, and exchange effective approaches with other regions.

  • Lead integrated B2B programs with Field Marketing across customer events, executive engagement, content, demand generation and sales enablement, connecting each activity to a clear audience need and outcome.

  • Partner with Sales/GTM on audience and account priorities, campaign follow-up and measures of pipeline contribution; connect commercial objectives with customer education and adoption.

  • Coordinate B2B partner and developer-facing programs with Partnerships, partnership marketing and Developer Marketing, agreeing responsibilities and relevance to the B2B plan.

  • Establish planning and reporting routines, manage delivery dependencies and budget trade-offs, and use performance evidence to improve programs and recommend where to invest next.

What you bring

  • 12+ years of marketing experience, including 5+ years in B2B marketing, ideally in technology, platforms or high-growth environments.

  • Proven experience building and delivering B2B programs in Brazil, with the ability to adapt strategy and execution across LATAM markets.

  • Deep understanding of business audiences and an insight-first approach, including enterprise buying dynamics, customer trust, local proof points and barriers to AI adoption.

  • Strong product marketing and storytelling skills. You explore products yourself and can translate complex capabilities into credible business use cases and clear customer value.

  • Experience partnering with Sales/GTM, Product Marketing, Comms and global or regional marketing teams, balancing shared strategy with local needs.

  • Hands-on experience across demand generation, field programs, customer education, content and sales enablement, including management of agencies, vendors and budgets.

  • Strong measurement and experimentation discipline, with the ability to connect activity to qualified engagement, pipeline contribution and adoption while explaining attribution limits.

  • A clear record of personal ownership: you can set direction, deliver high-quality work directly, build operating routines and make progress with incomplete inputs and limited resources.

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across local, regional and global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing AI or technical products, developing professional education or supporting business audiences connected to developer ecosystems.

  • Experience with partner-led programs, regulated or trust-sensitive industries, or a strong local network of B2B agencies and partners.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The GTM Strategy & Growth team drives the growth and evolution of our B2B business across products, customer segments, and routes to market. We partner closely with Product, Sales, Success, Data Science, Finance, and Marketing to define and execute go-to-market strategies for new product launches, commercialization models, customer growth initiatives, and market expansion opportunities.

Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, growth, and operations — shaping how we bring products to market, how we measure success, and how we scale adoption across customer segments. We operate across both strategic and highly operational domains, from defining long-term growth bets and commercial strategy to building launch plans, tracking performance, and driving cross-functional execution across the business.

About the Role

We’re looking for a strategic, hands-on individual contributor to join our GTM Strategy & Growth team and help shape how we grow and scale our B2B business across products, customer segments, and routes to market. This is a generalist role for someone who combines strong product intuition with thoughtful GTM strategy and can flex seamlessly between strategic thinking and operational execution.

You’ll translate business priorities into clear growth strategies, operating plans, and cross-functional execution. Your work may span product launches, commercialization models, customer growth initiatives, market expansion, and the systems and processes that help the business scale.

You should be highly analytical, comfortable working across a range of products and business problems, and experienced navigating complex cross-functional environments. Experience with technical or API-based products is valuable, but the most important qualities are strategic range, sound judgment, and the ability to turn customer, product, and market insights into practical recommendations and action.

This role is based in San Francisco office, 4-5 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive go-to-market strategy across products, customer segments, and routes to market, partnering closely with Product and GTM leaders to shape growth priorities and commercialization approaches.

  • Develop goals, launch success metrics, and operating KPIs for new initiatives, and monitor performance in partnership with Data Science and Analytics teams.

  • Develop growth strategies and strategic bets across new products, capabilities, customer motions, and market opportunities.

  • Develop customer segmentation frameworks and tailored strategies for different customer profiles, industries, and stages of adoption.

  • Partner with Product teams to provide structured customer feedback, market insights, and prioritization input that informs product roadmap decisions.

  • Collaborate with Pricing, Finance, and Product teams to develop commercial models, packaging, and monetization strategies, ensuring downstream GTM execution aligns with the broader commercial strategy.

  • Conduct market, competitive, and customer research to identify whitespace opportunities and inform strategic decision-making.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Operations to align on priorities and execute against business goals.

  • Analyze business performance and identify opportunities to improve GTM strategy and operating plans based on data, customer insights, and market dynamics.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience across GTM strategy, business operations, management consulting, product strategy, finance, or related functions in high-growth technology environments.

  • Bring strong fluency in data and analytics, with the ability to define meaningful success metrics, interpret performance trends, and drive data-informed decision-making.

  • Have experience working across multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market; experience with technical or API-based products is a plus.

  • Possess a broad understanding of B2B GTM operating models across Sales, Success, Product, Marketing, and Operations.

  • Have demonstrated success contributing to complex cross-functional initiatives that span strategy, operations, and execution.

  • Are equally comfortable developing strategic recommendations, solving ambiguous problems, and diving into operational details to ensure strong execution.

  • Bring strong product intuition and the ability to partner with Product teams on roadmap prioritization, customer insights, and commercialization strategy.

  • Have experience developing or evaluating pricing, packaging, monetization, or broader commercial strategies in partnership with Product and Finance teams.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and can bring structure and clarity to complex business problems across a range of contexts.

  • Are a clear communicator and collaborative partner who can build alignment across technical and non-technical teams.

jobs.title: B2B Communications Manager, LATAM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Achieving this goal requires more than cutting-edge research—it demands deep, ongoing engagement with the policymakers, communities, institutions, and partners shaping the future of AI.

The communications team supports this mission by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, products, and approach, helping business leaders, customers, partners, developers, policymakers, and the public understand how AI can be developed and adopted responsibly.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior B2B Communications Manager for Latam, based in São Paulo, to shape how businesses across the region understand OpenAI’s technology, products, and role in helping organizations adopt AI responsibly.

Reporting to the Head of Communications for LATAM, this role will own regional B2B communications strategy and execution, with a focus on helping business decision-makers, industry leaders, customers, partners, and the media understand the value and impact of OpenAI’s technology. You’ll shape how OpenAI communicates about enterprise adoption, customer outcomes, innovation, productivity, and responsible deployment across Latam markets.

This is a builder role for someone equally comfortable setting regional strategy, developing compelling business narratives, and helping local teams translate global priorities into communications that resonate in their markets. You’ll partner closely with global Communications, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product, Research, Safety, Legal, and Policy teams to deliver impact on the ground.

What you’ll do

  • Set and execute the Latam B2B communications strategy, aligned with regional business priorities, global narratives, and OpenAI’s mission

  • Develop clear, compelling narratives that show how organizations across Latam can use OpenAI’s technology to transform work, improve productivity, build new products and services, and drive growth

  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product, Research, Safety, Legal, Policy, and global Communications teams to turn complex technology, product developments, and company announcements into locally relevant communications

  • Lead earned media strategy for B2B audiences across the region, including national, business, technology, and relevant industry and trade media

  • Identify and develop customer and partner stories that demonstrate credible, measurable business outcomes and responsible AI adoption across Latam

  • Prepare executives, customers, partners, and subject-matter experts for high-impact communications, including media interviews, industry events, launches, customer engagements, and moments of scrutiny

  • Build repeatable communications programs around enterprise adoption, customer milestones, partnerships, and go-to-market priorities across Latam, not just one-off announcements

What you bring

  • 10+ years’ experience in B2B, corporate, product, or technology communications

  • Deep experience communicating enterprise technology, platforms, or technical products and translating complex capabilities into clear, accurate, and compelling business narratives

About the team

OpenAI’s Enterprise Go-To-Market organization helps the world’s largest companies adopt and scale our AI platform across their business—from ChatGPT Enterprise to our developer platform and APIs.

In Japan, we partner with leading organizations across industries including Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, Retail, and Technology to build new AI-powered customer experiences, transform operations, and reimagine how work gets done. As adoption accelerates through pilots, experimentation, and developer-led use cases, the GTM team turns that momentum into durable, enterprise-wide deployments.

Sales Development sits at the front of this motion—where technical curiosity becomes executive engagement and OpenAI’s enterprise relationships begin.

About the role

We are hiring a Sales Development Manager, Japan to lead and develop a team of SDRs supporting our enterprise business in Japan. Reporting into Sales Development leadership, this role will be responsible for coaching and developing a high-performing team focused on generating qualified pipeline and creating strategic opportunities across some of Japan’s largest and most influential organizations.

This is a foundational front-line leadership role within OpenAI’s Japan GTM organization. You will help define how we engage prospective customers in the Japanese market, convert product and developer interest into enterprise conversations, and build repeatable outbound and inbound motions that reflect the unique dynamics of enterprise selling in Japan.

You will partner closely with Japan Sales leadership, Account Directors, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Strategy & Operations, while connecting our Japan go-to-market motion with OpenAI’s broader regional and global strategy.

  • Drive high-quality pipeline generation through outbound prospecting, inbound qualification, account-based motions, and product-led signals

  • Build an SDR motion tailored to the Japanese enterprise market, including thoughtful account mapping, stakeholder engagement, and long-term relationship development

  • Establish strong operational rigor around activity metrics, conversion rates, pipeline quality, and execution consistency

  • Partner closely with Account Directors and Japan sales leadership on territory planning, account prioritization, and strategic opportunity development

  • Coach SDRs on executive communication, discovery, account research, strategic prospecting, and engaging senior stakeholders within large Japanese enterprises

  • Build a high-performance, collaborative, and low-ego team culture focused on continuous improvement

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, and Strategy & Operations to optimize pipeline generation efforts in Japan

  • Support the hiring, onboarding, and development of SDR talent as the Japan organization continues to scale

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, and the Japanese market back into the broader APAC and global GTM organization

You may thrive in this role if you

  • Have 6–10+ years of experience in sales, business development, or GTM roles, with significant experience in the Japanese market

  • Bring experience managing SDRs, BDRs, or business development teams in enterprise SaaS, cloud, platform, or other technology businesses

  • Have a strong understanding of enterprise prospecting, pipeline generation, and outbound strategy in Japan

  • Understand how large Japanese enterprises evaluate and adopt new technologies, and can navigate complex organizations with multiple stakeholders and long decision-making processes

  • Are highly operational and data-driven, with experience managing metrics, conversion funnels, pipeline performance, and forecasting

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are still being built and ambiguity is expected

  • Have experience partnering closely with Enterprise Sales teams on strategic account development

  • Are an exceptional coach who knows how to develop early-career talent into high-performing sales professionals

jobs.title: Software Engineer, API Frontiers
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

API Frontiers turns OpenAI’s frontier models into production APIs that developers can use to build reliable products and agents. We own the core path connecting models to developers through the Responses API, with a focus on safety, reliability, and speed. Working closely with Research, Safety, Codex, and other API teams, we bring new model capabilities into production and improve them through developer feedback.

About the Role

We are looking for a backend software engineer to build and operate the services behind the Responses API. You will shape API behavior, bring new capabilities from research into production, and make long-running agent workflows dependable and fast. The work combines distributed systems engineering with product judgment: designing useful developer interfaces, managing staged rollouts, and following production issues through to durable fixes.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate APIs and backend services that bring frontier model capabilities to developers.

  • Partner with Research, Safety, Codex, and API teams to define API behavior and deliver safe, staged launches.

  • Build API capabilities for agent workflows, including task delegation, context sharing, and parallel execution.

  • Strengthen long-running request reliability across timeouts, cancellation, streaming, and background execution.

  • Improve request-processing performance and tail latency through profiling, efficient systems code, and persistent connections.

  • Turn developer feedback and production failures into better observability, diagnostics, and lasting product improvements.

Your background might look something like:

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating backend services or developer-facing APIs in production.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with practical knowledge of distributed systems, concurrency, and asynchronous execution.

  • Ability to diagnose production failures and performance bottlenecks using observability data and profiling.

  • Product judgment and developer empathy, with a track record of translating complex capabilities into clear, dependable APIs.

  • Experience taking ownership of ambiguous technical problems, from defining an approach through shipping and improving the result.

  • Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering, research, product, and safety disciplines.

  • Experience with Rust, streaming protocols or WebSockets, or long-running workflow systems is a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Analyst Relations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports that mission by explaining our technology, our values, and how we safely build powerful AI. We help business leaders see what AI can make possible for their organizations, show how customers use OpenAI’s products, and explain how AI is changing the way people work.

Analyst Relations sits within Business Communications, helping industry analysts understand our technology, enterprise products, and how organizations put them to work.

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Analyst Relations to build OpenAI’s global analyst relations program and help influential analysts understand our enterprise products and the business outcomes they enable. You will set the narrative and engagement strategy, focusing on the firms and categories that shape enterprise buying decisions.

This is an exceptionally fast-paced, hands-on role. You will shape long-term positioning, advise senior leaders, and lead our participation in priority evaluations, briefings, and analyst engagement around launches. You will build trusted relationships while bringing Product, Research, Marketing, Sales, and Communications together to make decisions quickly and deliver exceptional work under tight deadlines.

This role reports to the Head of Business Communications. This role will be hybrid, in office 3 days a week, ideally in the San Francisco Bay Area; flexible on New York based candidates.

In this role, you will:

  • Set the global analyst relations strategy, prioritizing the firms, categories, and questions that shape enterprise technology decisions.

  • Lead OpenAI’s work on priority evaluations, from deciding where to engage through submissions, demos, and customer evidence.

  • Build a coherent enterprise narrative across a fast-moving product portfolio, grounded in what ships, customer outcomes, and responsible deployment.

  • Develop trusted, candid relationships with analysts through substantive briefings, regular updates, and follow-through on their questions.

  • Turn analyst feedback and competitive context into useful counsel for product and go-to-market teams, and track whether our positioning and analyst understanding improve.

  • Build a repeatable program with an evaluation calendar, briefing materials, approved customer references, and clear measures of relationship strength and evaluation outcomes.

  • Prepare executives and spokespeople for significant analyst moments, and help Communications and Sales use third-party research accurately in external and customer conversations.

You might thrive in this role, if you have:

  • Deep analyst relations experience in complex enterprise technology, including ownership of major evaluations.

  • A record of building programs with clear priorities and strong relationships, then turning analyst insight into useful counsel for the business.

  • Excellent judgment about what an analyst report says, what evidence supports customer and competitive claims, and what must remain confidential.

  • The credibility to work with technical leaders and make a sophisticated platform story clear to analysts and enterprise buyers.

  • Excellent writing and executive counsel skills, with the ability to align teams without formal authority.

  • A proven ability to move quickly between strategy and hands-on delivery under tight deadlines, while measuring progress through relationship strength, message understanding, and evaluation outcomes.

About OpenAI

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Developer Experience team at OpenAI has a singular focus: empowering developers globally. Our mission is to provide every developer and startup on the planet with the most delightful and seamless experience to integrate AI into their applications and products. We ensure developers have the tools, resources, and support they need to unlock AI’s full potential.

We create inspiring demos, developer tools, sample applications, and technical content that show developers how to build with Codex and frontier models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-Live, and GPT-Image-2.5 to create powerful agents and AI-native applications.

We collaborate closely with product, engineering, research, and GTM teams to ensure the developer journey, from onboarding with Codex to first API call to production deployment, is seamless, effective, and delightful.

About the Role

As a Developer Experience Engineer, Cyber, you will create technical content, developer tools, and sample applications that help developers and security teams secure the software they build and depend on. You will turn OpenAI’s cybersecurity capabilities, including Codex Security, into clear, runnable examples and useful learning experiences.

You will work directly with developers, security practitioners, and technical founders to understand their needs and show how AI can improve secure development and defensive security workflows. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who combines strong software skills, creativity, developer empathy, and curiosity about cybersecurity, and who can own projects from the first prototype through release and ongoing improvement.

In this role, you will:

  • Build demos, sample applications, and developer tools that demonstrate practical ways to use Codex, OpenAI’s APIs, and Cyber products for secure software development and defensive workflows.

  • Create tutorials, blog posts, videos, and code samples that help developers understand security findings, validate and prioritize vulnerabilities, review proposed changes, and verify fixes.

  • Develop reference integrations that connect AI-assisted security workflows to source control, code review, and continuous integration, helping teams move from initial setup to repeatable use.

  • Partner with Cyber engineers and security researchers to make examples technically accurate and results understandable, with clear guidance on evidence, validation, and the limitations of model-generated findings.

  • Demonstrate sound security practices in examples and tooling, including appropriate permissions, credential handling, protection of sensitive code and data, and human review of agent actions.

  • Engage developers and security practitioners through events, workshops, and online communities, serving as an approachable technical resource and advocate.

  • Gather and synthesize practitioner feedback to identify friction, inform product priorities, and improve the journey from onboarding to everyday use.

  • Contribute directly to developer-facing interfaces, documentation, and tooling, working with product, engineering, and go-to-market partners to help users adopt and succeed with OpenAI’s developer products.

Your background might look something like:

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping useful software, developer tools, or products for technical users.

  • Experience building applications with AI models, APIs, or agent workflows, and translating experimentation into reliable, maintainable code.

  • Experience with application security, vulnerability management, secure development workflows, or security tooling.

  • A portfolio of technical content, compelling demos, sample applications, or developer tooling that helps others learn and build.

  • Strong developer empathy and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly through writing, code, and conversation.

  • Experience collaborating across engineering, product, and technical user communities, with thoughtful judgment about usability, security, and correctness.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems end to end, learning unfamiliar domains, and iterating quickly as products and user needs evolve.

  • A commitment to responsible AI development and an interest in helping developers use powerful capabilities safely and effectively.

jobs.title: Researcher, Safety Training, National Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Safety Training research team aims to fundamentally advance our capabilities for precisely implementing safe behavior in AI models, and to leverage these advances to make OpenAI’s deployed models safe and beneficial. This requires a breadth of new ML research to address the growing set of safety challenges as AI becomes more powerful and used in more settings. Key focus areas include how to train nuanced safety behaviors, how to make the model robust to bad actors, how to address privacy and security risks, and how to make the model trustworthy in safety-critical situations.

We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely.

About the Role

We’re seeking a researcher to train and evaluate models for U.S. government use, with a focus on national security applications. You’ll advance safety post-training and robustness, helping models follow nuanced policies while preserving their usefulness and capabilities.

In this role, you will:

  • Research and implement methods for safety training, reinforcement learning, and adversarial robustness.

  • Develop evaluations, identify model failure modes, and use findings to improve training.

  • Work with research, engineering, security, and policy partners to support safe, reliable deployment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring 4+ years of relevant AI safety research experience, including RLHF, adversarial training, or robustness.

  • Have a degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, and strong deep learning research or engineering skills.

  • Have experience improving model safety for deployment and enjoy collaborative research.

  • Are motivated by OpenAI’s mission and the responsible use of AI in safety-critical settings.

  • Active TS/SCI clearance or equivalent.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. We connect global product innovation with local consumer needs, culture and behavior across Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America, contributing to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

We bring together strategy and creativity across integrated campaigns, product launches, creators, social, partnerships and cultural experiences. Working with global and local cross-functional teams, we make AI’s everyday usefulness tangible and relevant to people across the region.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Integrated Marketing Manager to lead consumer marketing programs across LATAM, with an immediate focus on Brazil and close collaboration across Spanish-speaking markets. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

You will turn consumer insight and product understanding into a clear strategy, a compelling creative idea and an integrated plan that delivers measurable results. You should be as comfortable exploring an AI product and writing a brief as aligning global stakeholders, guiding creative development and driving execution. Your work will help people discover useful applications of ChatGPT and build confidence in new capabilities. This role is based in Brazil; São Paulo, hybrid model.

In this role, you will:

  • Build consumer strategies from research, market signals and local cultural insight, identifying the audience, unmet need and behavior each program should influence.

  • Translate product features, AI capabilities and real product behavior into clear consumer use cases, messaging and brand storytelling, with accurate expectations about capabilities and limitations.

  • Lead integrated campaigns from brief to launch and learning, giving paid, owned, earned, social, creators, partnerships and experiences distinct, complementary roles.

  • Adapt global launches and campaigns to local needs while protecting the core brand strategy; create locally originated ideas when the opportunity calls for them.

  • Connect cultural relevance with practical product utility, helping both existing users and new audiences move from discovery to trial, broader usage and repeat engagement.

  • Partner with creator, social and partnership teams to sustain product education between major launches and turn cultural moments into a consistent marketing presence.

  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Brand, Creative, Production, Comms, Data and Regional teams to align priorities, messaging, channel plans and launch readiness, including when timelines change quickly.

  • Define success and learning plans before launch, using relevant brand and behavioral metrics and experimentation where feasible.

  • Manage campaign resources, agencies, budgets and production dependencies within agreed authority; make clear trade-offs and build forward plans that account for creative lead times and local market conditions.

What you bring

  • 12+ years of technology marketing experience across Brazil and Spanish-speaking LATAM, with a proven record of leading integrated B2C programs and hands-on experience marketing AI products.

  • Deep local market knowledge and an insight-first approach

  • Strong product marketing expertise and genuine product curiosity. You explore AI tools yourself and can turn complex capabilities into useful, credible consumer stories.

  • Strong strategic and creative judgment, connecting brand positioning, product value and distribution to a compelling central campaign idea.

  • Understanding of the full consumer journey and how marketing contributes to awareness, acquisition, activation, adoption, engagement, retention or monetization, depending on the objective.

  • Strong measurement and experimentation discipline, with the ability to distinguish activity and platform metrics from business impact and explain attribution limits.

  • Experience balancing regional consistency with local nuance, and influencing cross-functional and global teams without relying on formal authority.

  • A clear record of personal ownership: you can set direction, produce high-quality work directly, manage agencies and delivery, and make progress with incomplete inputs and limited resources.

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across local, regional and global teams.

Nice to have

  • An established network of local creative, media, creator or cultural partners, and experience reaching audiences beyond the region’s largest urban centers.

  • Experience connecting consumer product adoption with professional use cases, or building reusable launch and campaign practices across markets.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment.

About the Role

As a Legal Program Manager focused on regulatory compliance, you will build and manage cross-functional programs that translate counsel’s guidance into practical, sustainable operations. Your initial focus may include content moderation and/or frontier AI governance, with the mix shaped by team priorities and your strengths.

You will partner with internal and external counsel, other legal program managers, and technical and business teams to coordinate implementation, evidence collection, reporting, and ongoing compliance. You’ll build repeatable systems that scale across regulations, products, and jurisdictions, helping teams navigate emerging requirements with clarity and sound judgment.

This full-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead regulatory compliance programs end to end: define scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths, and drive execution with counsel and cross-functional partners.

  • Translate counsel’s regulatory guidance into repeatable workflows, controls, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include content moderation disclosures, transparency reporting, reporting and appeals workflows, or frontier AI model launch readiness, evaluation and risk-management evidence, and incident reporting.

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, User Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Global Affairs, Communications, and Go-to-Market to align program priorities and deliverables.

  • Support regulatory inquiries, audits and investigations with counsel, organizing evidence and responses to support timely, accurate communication and reporting.

  • Maintain a reliable source of truth for obligations, controls, decisions, evidence, and reporting. Demonstrate compliance readiness and control effectiveness, and improve program timeliness and evidence quality.

  • Identify execution risks and compliance gaps, track remediation, and escalate blockers. Establish clear success measures and operating cadences, keeping legal conclusions subject to counsel’s review.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in program management, regulatory compliance, or related fields in a tech-forward or highly regulated environment, including relevant legal, regulatory, or compliance program experience.

  • Have experience working with an in-house legal team; regulatory matters experience and in-house technology experience are strongly preferred.

  • Have demonstrated experience building and scaling compliance programs, translating legal or regulatory requirements into operational workflows, and maintaining reliable documentation and evidence in partnership with counsel.

  • Take ownership of complex projects, set and achieve milestones, synthesize cross-functional input, and build trust across legal, technical, and business teams.

  • Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and make progress through ambiguity.

  • Are resourceful and hands-on, with enthusiasm for AI technology and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technical concepts and navigate fast-moving technical environments.

  • Bring familiarity with content moderation, online safety, frontier AI governance, data governance, privacy, or emerging technology law as a plus. Depth in either content moderation or frontier AI governance is valuable; expertise in both is not required.

  • Bring data analysis or SQL skills, or relevant professional qualifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CPA, or CISSP, as a plus.

OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. You will turn consumer insight and product understanding into creator programs and partnership activations that help people discover useful applications of ChatGPT, build confidence in new capabilities and use them more often. The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence in Korea. Reporting to the General Manager, Korea, this leader will work hand in hand with the General Manager to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor.

This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind.

This role is based in Seoul, Korea and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Defining and implementing the Korea operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities.

  • Driving execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics.

  • Partnering with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region.

  • Establishing KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making.

  • Building and optimizing scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions.

  • Identifying operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Supporting market entry strategies and operational readiness for Korea

  • Enabling strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams.

  • Helping build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently.

  • Collaborating closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals.

  • Ensuring seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders.

  • Acting as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across Korea.

  • Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing regional operations team.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

  • Developing leadership bench strength across key markets and functions.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment.

  • Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans.

  • Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within Korea.

  • A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.

  • Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes.

  • Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives.

  • Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The mission of the Applied AI Engineering team is to enable the secure and impactful implementation of Agentic solutions. In this international Government role, you will deliver clearly scoped AI use cases with public-sector customers, from a mission need through hands-on implementation, architecture, evaluations, measurable adoption, and documented handoff. Account-aligned technical and commercial owners retain ongoing account ownership.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven solutions leader with a product mindset to partner with our international public-sector customers and ensure they achieve tangible value with GenAI. You will pair with government agencies, policymakers, and other public institutions to establish a GenAI strategy and identify the highest value applications. You’ll partner with their technical teams, subject matter experts, regional cloud providers, systems integrators, and implementation partners to move from prototype through production. You’ll design architectures using supported OpenAI technologies and approved services, with explicit data, inference, evaluation, and production-readiness boundaries. You will collaborate closely with regional Sales and Solutions Engineering, Global Affairs, Applied Research, Product, Legal, and Security teams.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver clearly scoped technical implementations with sophisticated international public-sector customers, serving as their hands-on engineering partner to build applications on supported model APIs, Codex, and other approved OpenAI technologies.

  • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify the best applications of GenAI in their industry and to build/qualify a comprehensive backlog to support their AI roadmap.

  • Intervene directly to accelerate customer time to value through building hands-on prototypes and/or by delivering impactful strategic guidance, often in collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.

  • Forge and manage relationships with our customers’ and implementation partners’ leadership and stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment and scale of their applications.

  • Contribute to our open-source developer and enterprise resources.

  • Scale the Applied AI Engineering function through sharing knowledge, codifying best practices, and publishing notebooks to our internal and external repositories.

  • Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to the Product, Engineering, and Research teams.

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring substantial technical consulting or hands-on delivery experience with international public-sector or similarly regulated customers, bridging regional technical teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Have successfully led GenAI or traditional ML implementations for government agencies in close collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners.

  • Understand network and cloud architecture, including on-premise deployments, and show practical judgment about privacy, data residency, model-inference location, sovereign or regulated environments, identity, procurement, and customer authorization.

  • Are an effective and polished communicator who can translate business and technical topics to all audiences, including cross-cultural communication with public-sector executives, regional delivery partners, and legal/security stakeholders.

  • Have industry experience in programming languages like Python, Go, or Typescript.

  • Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done.

  • Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed.

  • Are an effective, high throughput operator who can drive multiple concurrent projects and prioritize ruthlessly.

  • Can work with stakeholders in the target region's business hours and travel when required for customer delivery.

  • Existing UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is strongly preferred, particularly for work with UK intelligence and defense customers.

jobs.title: EMEA Strategy and Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. Our EMEA organization translates OpenAI’s global mission and strategy into meaningful local impact, working across Growth, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance.

About the Role

As EMEA Strategy and Operations lead, you will develop country and regional strategies, identify the most important market opportunities and barriers, align cross-functional teams around a focused set of priorities, and personally drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role. The primary focus is Consumer, with opportunities to create adjacent impact across B2B. You will go deep in a small number of priority markets while building approaches that can scale across EMEA.

This is not a strategy-only role. The successful candidate will combine rigorous analysis and market judgment with urgency, hands-on execution and the ability to influence without formal authority.

This role is based in London or Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Build country and regional strategies: Develop plans, priorities and forecasts for key European markets and translate company strategy into practical local action.

  • Drive growth and conversion: Use data, customer insight and experimentation to improve acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.

  • Lead market expansion and localization: Identify opportunities, build scalable launch frameworks and determine where products and go-to-market should adapt.

  • Turn strategy into execution: Personally move initiatives from diagnosis and prioritization through delivery, measurement and iteration.

  • Lead cross-functional teams: Align Product, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance around shared outcomes.

  • Represent regional insight: Ensure European market and customer perspectives shape global roadmaps and decisions.

  • Measure and scale impact: Define success metrics and determine when a successful local approach should be replicated.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 10 years + of experience in growth, strategy, business operations or quantitative analytics with meaningful responsibility for outcomes.

  • Have developed country, regional or multi-market strategies and translated them into focused execution plans.

  • Bring exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, including forecasting, financial modeling and growth metrics.

  • Can show examples of personally taking initiatives from insight through launch and measurement.

  • Understand European markets while maintaining a regional and scalable perspective.

  • Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and influence teams without formal authority.

  • Operate with high ownership and urgency in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments.

  • Have a deep interest in AI and alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer, pAGI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

pAGI Infra team builds and operates the systems that make large-scale model training and evaluation reliable, efficient, and easy to run. Our work spans distributed training infrastructure, inference and grading platforms, compute scheduling, and research tooling. We partner closely with researchers and engineering teams to turn new research needs into dependable infrastructure, improve GPU efficiency, and shorten the path from an experiment to a validated model.

About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Systems Engineer to help scale the infrastructure behind our training and evaluation workflows. You’ll own projects from identifying bottlenecks and designing solutions through deployment and operation. The work combines distributed systems engineering, performance optimization, and close collaboration with researchers. You might build a shared grading service, improve resource allocation across workloads, or bring a new training stack into production — directly improving how quickly and reliably research moves forward.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and operate infrastructure for large-scale training and evaluation, improving reliability, throughput, and resource efficiency.

  • Develop shared inference and grading platforms with automated capacity management, health monitoring, and visibility into performance.

  • Improve compute scheduling and resource allocation to reduce idle GPU time and help workloads recover quickly from failures.

  • Diagnose bottlenecks across training, inference, and orchestration, and work across teams to improve end-to-end performance.

  • Build self-service tools, automated validation, and observability that help researchers launch experiments, diagnose issues, and compare results with less manual intervention.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are excited about the potential of personal AGI and want to build the infrastructure that enables it.

  • Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems.

  • Have experience in ML infrastructure, inference systems, GPU performance, or infrastructure tooling.

  • Are highly self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of open-ended problems.

  • Enjoy debugging across system boundaries and using measurements to guide improvements in performance and reliability.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Sales team partners closely with customers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform—while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity.

jobs.title: Business Systems Lead, Procure-to-Pay
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Finance Platform & Technology team builds and scales the systems and data architecture that power OpenAI’s core financial operations. We enable business agility, compliance, and operational excellence across procure-to-pay, quote-to-cash, supply chain, financial planning, and asset management. We partner with Procurement, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Security, Data, and Engineering to modernize workflows through thoughtful platform design, reliable integrations, scalable automation, and trusted data.

About the Role

As a Business Systems Lead for Procure-to-Pay, you will be a hands-on engineer who designs, builds, and operates the integrations and first-party applications that power OpenAI’s procurement workflows. You will translate business needs into secure, scalable software, APIs, data flows, and automation across Oracle Fusion, Zip, and connected platforms.

You will build the future of buying at OpenAI using OpenAI’s own technology, from guided intake and approval experiences to supplier onboarding, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and downstream financial data flows. You will own the technical roadmap and support model for these capabilities, improving today’s platforms while deciding where to integrate, configure, or build as OpenAI scales.

Your core strength will be software and integration engineering. You will personally write code, troubleshoot cross-system failures, and take solutions through testing, deployment, and production support. You will also make targeted functional configurations in procurement platforms and partner with functional specialists on deeper process and module design.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate integrations across Oracle Fusion, Zip, and connected systems using APIs, events, messaging, and batch interfaces where appropriate.

  • Build first-party procurement applications, backend services, and user-facing workflows that simplify intake, approvals, transaction visibility, and exception resolution.

  • Write maintainable code and reusable integration components, with version control, code review, automated tests, and repeatable deployment and rollback practices.

  • Define data contracts, mappings, durable identifiers, lifecycle states, and authoritative data ownership so transactions remain accurate and traceable across systems.

  • Engineer reliable processing through validation, idempotency, retries, monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, recovery, and readback from the system of record.

  • Build and evaluate AI-enabled workflows using OpenAI technology, with scoped tool access, explicit approval boundaries, audit trails, and safe handling of errors or uncertain outputs.

  • Make targeted Oracle Fusion and Zip configuration changes that support delivered workflows, such as intake fields, routing, approvals, and supplier settings, in partnership with Procurement, AP, and functional specialists.

  • Own technical testing and release readiness, including integration and regression tests, business UAT, migration validation, staged rollout, and operational documentation.

  • Own the long-term procurement applications and integrations roadmap, prioritizing reusable capabilities and making clear build-versus-configure decisions with business and engineering partners.

  • Own production health and incident resolution, protect access and financial controls, and deliver durable fixes that reduce failed transactions, manual intervention, and procurement cycle time.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience in enterprise integrations, software engineering, or business systems engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for building and operating production solutions.

  • Can personally write, review, test, and debug production code in a language such as Python or TypeScript, and use SQL to investigate data quality, reconcile systems, and validate outcomes.

  • Have hands-on experience integrating with Oracle Fusion and understanding how Procurement and Payables transactions move through its APIs, data models, and interfaces.

  • Have designed and shipped APIs, services, or internal applications, and can explain your implementation choices, failure modes, and results in production.

  • Understand REST APIs, JSON, authentication and authorization, data modeling, and event-driven or message-based integration patterns.

  • Have built and operated integrations using OIC, Workato, or comparable platforms, and can choose when custom code, native APIs, or an integration platform best fits the problem.

  • Have owned production troubleshooting and service reliability, including observability, retries, reconciliation, incident response, and safe recovery.

  • Understand the P2P lifecycle and how approvals, supplier data, purchase orders, receiving, matching, invoices, and payments affect downstream accounting and controls.

  • Can make targeted functional configuration changes and validate their business impact, while partnering with specialists for deeper module design. Experience with Zip is a plus.

  • Apply secure engineering and financial-control practices, including least-privilege access, segregation of duties, sensitive-change approvals, and auditable transaction histories.

  • Communicate clearly with Procurement, AP, Accounting, Risk, and Engineering, turn ambiguous needs into working software, and bring curiosity about building and evaluating AI-enabled applications.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager, Growth & Revenue
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Applied organization brings OpenAI’s most advanced technology to the world through products like ChatGPT and the APIs that power a growing ecosystem of developer and enterprise applications. Data Engineering builds and operates the trustworthy, secure, and reliable data systems that power decisions across OpenAI.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Engineering Manager to lead the Growth & Revenue data engineering team. This leader will own the data strategy and execution for the data subject areas spanning growth accounting across all product surfaces, product partnerships, checkout, billing, payments, revenue, and monetization, helping OpenAI understand how people adopt, engage with, and pay for our products. You will partner closely with several Data Science, Business, and Engineering partners to connect product behavior to trustworthy subscriber, payment, and revenue measurement.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, manage, and grow a high-performing, inclusive team across the Growth & Revenue data subject areas.

  • Define the data strategy for all the data subject areas you own.

  • Deliver durable, well-modeled data products that connect product behavior, subscription state, checkout events, payment outcomes, and revenue.

  • Establish trusted metric definitions and data quality standards so product, growth, finance, and executive leaders can make fast, consistent decisions.

  • Partner with Data Science and Product teams to support experimentation, causal measurement, funnel analysis, and scalable self-serve analytics.

  • Partner with Finance and Financial Engineering to ensure analytical revenue views reconcile to financial truth and production billing systems.

  • Raise operational excellence for critical pipelines, including reliability, observability, privacy, governance, and incident response.

  • Set a clear roadmap, make principled tradeoffs, and communicate progress and risk across technical and business stakeholders.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have deep experience leading and scaling data engineering teams in a fast-moving product or technology environment.

  • Bring strong technical judgment across modern data systems, including SQL, Python or Scala, Spark, orchestration, dimensional and event modeling, and lakehouse or warehouse architectures.

  • Have built trusted growth, lifecycle, attribution, subscription, billing, payments, revenue, or monetization data products at meaningful scale.

  • Can turn ambiguous business questions into durable data contracts, metric definitions, and technical roadmaps.

  • Build unusually strong partnerships with Data Science, Product, Finance, Financial Engineering, GTM, and Engineering.

  • Care deeply about data quality, privacy, security, and the operational health of systems used for consequential decisions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform.

We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels.

About the role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising to bring together advertiser insights, market understanding, and product knowledge to shape positioning, inform product priorities, and deliver go-to-market initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Partnerships to understand advertiser needs, translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, and bring new products and features to market. This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, independently navigates ambiguity, and brings cross-functional partners together to deliver results.

In this role you will:

  • Define the product and marketing strategy for a component of OpenAI’s advertising business in partnership with cross-functional partners

  • Develop a deep understanding of advertisers through customer research, market analysis, and competitive insights, identifying opportunities to improve positioning, adoption, and product-market fit.

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating complex capabilities into compelling narratives for different advertiser audiences and use cases.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring advertiser needs and market insights into roadmap discussions and product decisions.

  • Develop and drive go-to-market plans for new products and features, owning marketing execution from planning through launch and ongoing adoption.

  • Create advertiser-facing content and sales enablement materials, including product narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, and launch communications.

  • Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Data Science, and Analytics to define success metrics, assess launch and adoption performance, and turn findings into improvements.

  • Surface advertiser concerns and launch risks related to performance, safety, policy, and trust, working with the relevant teams to address them in launch plans and customer communications.

  • Align cross-functional partners around priorities, responsibilities, and timelines, making thoughtful tradeoffs and resolving blockers within your initiatives.

  • Build repeatable approaches to launches, messaging, and enablement, sharing learnings and mentoring peers to improve the team’s storytelling and execution.

You might be a great fit if you…

  • Have experience independently developing product and marketing strategies and bringing products to market, particularly in advertising, marketing technology, platforms, or data and AI.

  • Have experience in structured problem solving environments including but not limited to strategy/management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy and venture capital

  • Understand advertiser goals and the advertising ecosystem, including measurement, targeting and relevance, creative, auctions, and performance tradeoffs.

  • Can turn customer research and market insights into clear positioning, actionable go-to-market plans, and recommendations that inform product priorities.

  • Communicate clearly and persuasively, translating technical concepts into differentiated customer value for a range of audiences.

  • Use qualitative and quantitative evidence—including customer interviews, surveys, adoption data, and experiments—to make decisions and improve results.

  • Bring structured problem solving and strong judgment to ambiguous challenges, independently setting priorities and managing initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Build effective partnerships across Product, Engineering, Sales, and other teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment without formal authority.
